objective: Resolve the remaining exact archive collisions at ZIP-member granularity without changing the definitive v13 verdict or claiming efficacy.
factor: unanimous exact member-level cote attribution for the frozen unresolved-collision population

preregistration_amendment.reason: Corrected two source paths copied from the v13 contract after the first v14 invocation stopped with FileNotFoundError before loading any attribution or coverage result.

council_authorization.override_of_v13_failure_rule: A final bounded deterministic provenance join is allowed only as preparation for future collision screening; v13 remains permanently partial_recovery.

population_contract.predeclared_432_subset: unique_archive_without_unique_codex rows whose unique_archive is not t_tepeuc.zip

attribution_contract.member_mapping: PurePosixPath(member_name).stem.casefold() exact equality with elements.csv cote.casefold(), then codexid
attribution_contract.acceptance_rule: Attribute only if every exact colliding member maps to exactly one codex and all mapped codex ids are identical.
attribution_contract.unmapped_member_rule: Any colliding member without an exact cote mapping keeps the row unresolved.
attribution_contract.multi_codex_member_rule: Any member stem mapping to more than one codex keeps the row unresolved.
attribution_contract.byte_rgb_conflict_rule: Any divergent codex identity across the union of byte and RGB collisions keeps the row unresolved.
attribution_contract.deduplication: Deduplicate members by archive_name and member_index before convergence.
